verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting to disable telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. The nearby claims are adjacent features, not an opt-out: SOC 2/ISO certifications, data staying on monday's servers, and admin audit of agent actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
